  Two ways to keep a moving sprite clean, and what they cost.
  'silhouette' draws only the 45%-odd of the box the sprite covers
  and puts the whole box back first; 'opaque' draws every byte of
  the box with the backdrop baked in, and only has to clear where
  the sprite has just left.

  level    silh+erase   % frame   a frame      opaque   % frame   a frame

  48x60         21255     17.7%       5.6       14607     12.2%       8.2
  32x40         11276      9.4%      10.6        7289      6.1%      16.5
